title: I found my DELETED Korean Convenience Store video from 5 years ago... 😭
description:
Oh my gosh, I can't believe I found this footage! 😱 

About four and a half years ago, I filmed and posted a "Yellow Convenience Store Food Challenge" where I had to find and eat only yellow food. Sadly, the original video got deleted... but today, I finally recovered the lost files! 💛

Join me as I react to my past self, look back at these nostalgic convenience store treats, and cringed/laughed at how much has changed since then. 

Did you remember the original video, or are you seeing this footage for the first time? Let me know in the comments below!
